description: 6,015 structured keywords across 20 categories. Sources: MidJourney Reference + Danbooru + Danbooru Booster/Civitai + Web Research + @nodaro/prompts (v1.27.0). v1.1.0 consolidated 33 → 20 categories; v1.1.1 removed 14 true-duplicate terms (see docs/CATEGORY_CONSOLIDATION.md). Additional high-quality keywords added in v1.8.1 including quality (27), held-prop (6), framing (6), panel (5), character-fx (5), action-fx (3), photographer (2). pws-translate.py optimized (9,130 lines removed, data externalized).
